declare @strKey nvarchar(3000) set @strKey =' ma_ct = ''FCL''' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join vdmcangdi d on a.ma_noi_di = d.ma_noi_di left join vdmcangden f on a.ma_noi_den = f.ma_noi_den', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_kh, d.ten_noi_di, f.ten_noi_den, cast(0 as numeric(19, 2)) tien_mua, cast(0 as numeric(19, 2)) tien_ch, cast(0 as numeric(19, 2)) tien_ban, cast(0 as numeric(19, 2)) as tien_th', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId, 'select id_dh, SUM(ISNULL(t_tieny2,0)) tien_mua, SUM(ISNULL(t_tienx2,0)) tien_ch into #m72 from m72 where ma_ct= ''PN1'' GROUP BY id_dh; update #v set tien_mua = b.tien_mua, tien_ch = b.tien_ch from #v a join #m72 b on a.id = b.id_dh; select id_dh, SUM(ISNULL(t_tieny2,0)) tien_ban, SUM(ISNULL(t_tienx2,0)) tien_th into #m54 from m54 where ma_ct= ''PX3'' GROUP BY id_dh; update #v set tien_ban = b.tien_ban, tien_th = b.tien_th from #v a join #m54 b on a.id = b.id_dh;' drop table #unitright
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = '' if @cont_no <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.cont_no like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@cont_no) + '%''' if @seal_no <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.seal_no like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@seal_no) + '%'''
if @strDetailKey <> '' set @strDetailKey = ' and exists(select 1 from v61 x where a.id = x.id ' + @strDetailKey + ')'
set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding + ' and ' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionGetUnitIDRightKeys(@@admin, @@userId, @ma_unit, 'a.unit_id') + @strDetailKey set @strKey = @strKey +' and ma_ct = ''FCL''' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join vdmcangdi d on a.ma_noi_di = d.ma_noi_di left join vdmcangden f on a.ma_noi_den = f.ma_noi_den', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_kh, d.ten_noi_di, f.ten_noi_den, cast(0 as numeric(19, 2)) tien_mua, cast(0 as numeric(19, 2)) tien_ch, cast(0 as numeric(19, 2)) tien_ban, cast(0 as numeric(19, 2)) as tien_th', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId, 'select id_dh, SUM(ISNULL(t_tieny2,0)) tien_mua, SUM(ISNULL(t_tienx2,0)) tien_ch into #m72 from m72 where ma_ct= ''PN1'' GROUP BY id_dh; update #v set tien_mua = b.tien_mua, tien_ch = b.tien_ch from #v a join #m72 b on a.id = b.id_dh; select id_dh, SUM(ISNULL(t_tieny2,0)) tien_ban, SUM(ISNULL(t_tienx2,0)) tien_th into #m54 from m54 where ma_ct= ''PX3'' GROUP BY id_dh; update #v set tien_ban = b.tien_ban, tien_th = b.tien_th from #v a join #m54 b on a.id = b.id_dh;' drop table #unitright
